description: A sprite sheet of EIGHT separate fish item icons arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell, every fish drawn in side view facing right. Top row: a small silver crucian carp, a bronze common carp with big scales, a striped green perch with a spiny fin, a long slim brown rice-field eel. Bottom row: a blue-grey freshwater crayfish with big claws, a rare shiny golden koi carp with sparkles, a dark night catfish with long whiskers, a rare glittering fish with pale teal glowing scales and star-like sparkles. Chunky simple game item icons, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every item fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no water, no text, no numbers

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
